vehicle_identity: Custom four independently driven/steered modules. Not an EKS 215a replica.

sources.caveats: Historical 48 V version. New 24 V products differ. Sheet axle masses sum to 3280 kg, not 3140 kg; inconsistent axle split is excluded. Motor output/duty is not pump DC input. Original 2/1x running gear is not adopted.

sources.document: Drive wheels series, GVUN 304/60H7; G16 catalogue p546 cross-check
sources.caveats: Drive wheel component reference. No claim that this wheel is fitted to EKS. Ratings are per catalogue conditions, not simulated strength or a load-deflection curve. Catalogue PDF unavailable; manufacturer webpage verified.
Material-series reference only. EKS fork manufacturer, grade and ultimate fracture stress are not identified.

sources.document: Tellus S2 MX 46 TDS v4.4, 2026-09-18, page 2
sources.caveats: Selected reference fluid properties. Not an EKS fluid recommendation or identified factory fill. Density held constant in prototype.

bindings.note: Chassis mass is the residual after assumed module masses and fork geometry-derived masses. Actual OEM COM/inertia is unknown.

unidentified_parameters: OEM component masses, COM and inertia
tyre radial/shear stiffness, damping, friction and pressure map
fork Young modulus, damping, true taper, heel fillet, ultimate stress and fatigue
mast/cylinder dimensions, actual rope path, chain stiffness and mass
hose compliance, routing, valves and pump maps
oil heat capacity, tank thermal mass and cooling
not_imported_as_oem_values: 3 kW drive output is not divided by four to manufacture four motor specifications
9.5 kW intermittent lift output is not substituted for DC pump input
Shore hardness is not converted into measured tyre stiffness
catalogue capacity is not equated to a deformation or failure threshold
active_drive_note: Default is now custom mecanum. The original independently-steered modules and Blickle wheel rating below are historical regular-wheel references; they are not a mecanum rating. See Mecanum.json catalogue_comparison and Docs/MecanumPropertyCalibration.md.
